entries.title: Draft Commission guidelines on the classification of high-risk AI systems
entries.summary: Draft Commission guidance on which AI systems count as high-risk under the EU AI Act, with sections on general principles and Annexes I and III. The document is a draft and is not legally binding.

entries.title: Safer and more transparent AI: new transparency rules for AI systems take effect
entries.summary: Transparency rules for AI systems took effect on 2026-08-02. Certain AI-generated or manipulated content must be labelled with machine-readable marks, and users must be told when they are interacting with an AI system. The Commission has published guidelines to help providers and deployers comply; the article does not say whether they are final.
